name: pastepop
description: Windows-style clipboard history popup for GNOME Shell

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp -r metadata.json stylesheet.css schemas data dist/ && glib-compile-schemas dist/schemas
scripts.pack: npm run build && gnome-extensions pack dist --force --out-dir=. --extra-source=core --extra-source=shell --extra-source=ui --extra-source=prefs --extra-source=data
scripts.deploy: npm run pack && gnome-extensions install --force pastepop@abulgit.shell-extension.zip && gnome-extensions enable pastepop@abulgit
